# docker_tag

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Adds a tag to an image already on the provider's daemon, like `docker tag SOURCE TARGET`. Create calls `ImageTag`; refresh inspects `target_image` and plans a re-tag when the tag is gone or now points at a different image than `source_image`. Destroy untags `target_image` only (`ImageRemove` on the tag, never by ID); when it is the image's only tag it is left in place with a warning, so the source image is never removed. Every argument forces a new resource.

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_image" "app" {
  name = "nginx:1.27"
}

# Same image under a second name, e.g. before pushing it to a private registry.
resource "docker_tag" "release" {
  source_image = docker_image.app.id
  target_image = "registry.example.com/web/nginx:stable"

  # Re-tag whenever the source image is rebuilt.
  triggers = { source = docker_image.app.id }
}

output "tag_ref" {
  value = docker_tag.release.image_ref
}

output "tagged_image_id" {
  value = docker_tag.release.source_image_id
}
```
